`interface NodeLayer`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.ui.node.layer` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [NodeLayer.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/ui/node/layer/NodeLayer.java)

Function that draws over a node, after its children, in the coordinates of the node.

## Description

Add one with [`Node.layer(NodeLayer)`](/reference/nodes/node/#Node-method-layer).
It runs on the render thread at every frame where the node is drawn.
